worldcombat.skill.magicroom.summary: Raises a silent space on the chosen ground: bodies standing inside lose every held-item effect. Both sides are treated alike, and stepping out restores you at once.
worldcombat.skill.magicroom.use.0: Shut down a foe that leans on its item
worldcombat.skill.magicroom.use.1: Make items useless before an item exchange
worldcombat.skill.magicroom.use.2: Let an item-independent team take the edge
Raises a space of radius %2$s blocks on the chosen ground, lasting %1$s.
Current range: %1$s blocks. The room affects both sides.
Raising the space takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the hush note for the long/quick trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.magicroom.hush.0: Long: duration x1.2 and radius x1.1 (silent longer, wider), at +2 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.magicroom.hush.1: Quick: duration x0.8 and radius x0.9 (shorter, smaller), in exchange for no extra wind-up and x0.85 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.magicroom.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to raise the space, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.magicroom.preference.h: Long: duration x1.2, radius x1.1, +2 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — good to shut a foe's item down for a long time. Quick: duration x0.8, radius x0.9, x0.85 cooldown — good for moving often and hushing only the clash point.
worldcombat.skill.magicroom.preference.a: The companion only considers the magic room while a threat is within this distance; lower presses it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the space at the foe
On, the space is pressed between you and the threat so the fighting line is hushed too; off, it is pressed at your feet to hush yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to raise the space.
